report.answer: A basketball drops from upper left and bounces across the floor to the right, each arc lower than the last. The path is decisively a gravity-driven bounce with g ~9.8 m/s² and restitution ~0.78, losing ~39% energy per impact. Cyan fit overlays yellow centres to <3 px vs 31 px radius.
assumptions: camera still, motion in plane facing camera
scale from standard basketball diameter 0.24+-0.01 m at same depth as motion

forks.label: same throw on Moon
forks.why: lower g gives higher slower arcs

forks.label: beanbag thud
forks.why: single impact then roll with no rebound

report.headline: Bouncing basketball: g=9.8 m/s², e=0.78
